name: venom-button
title: Venom Button
description: A glossy black pill that hunts for a host. Come near and pseudopods ooze out and feel toward the cursor; get close and they lunge, each one wrapping a finger of a cartoon glove. Pull away and they stretch, snap and melt back into the button, which wobbles and throws up a few spikes.
